definitions.explanation: The destination to which mail, email, data, or phone calls are redirected from the original address or number.

examples.japanese: {転送先|てんそうさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{転送先|てんそうさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}して→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please change the email forwarding destination.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}→郵便物：18044_yuubinbutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{転送先|てんそうさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}た→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧。
examples.english: When moving, I submitted a forwarding address for my mail.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{転送|てんそう}→転送：14792_tensou⟧ (forwarding; transfer) and ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination). Used in both digital contexts (email forwarding, call forwarding, data transfer) and physical contexts (mail forwarding after moving).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転送先|てんそうさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set a forwarding destination
- {転送先|てんそうさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change the forwarding destination
- {転送先|てんそうさき}⟦アドレス→アドレス：27003_adoresu⟧: forwarding address
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{転送先|てんそうさき}: call forwarding destination

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{送付先|そうふさき}→送付先：23788_soufusaki⟧: delivery destination — where something is sent to (not redirected)
- ⟦{宛先|あてさき}→宛先：12275_atesaki⟧: addressee; destination address — the intended recipient
- ⟦{転居先|てんきょさき}→転居先：29866_tenkyosaki⟧: new address (after moving) — specifically about a residential address change
